full_judgment: 5. Referring to Article 143 of the Constitution, he goes to contend that all minerals of the country vests to the Republic and, as such, the people of the country are the real and actual owner and proprietor of all the minerals of the country. However, the executive organ, while dealing, transecting or using such property can act only as the trustee of the people's property. Our Constitution, he argues, does not contemplate whimsical, arbitrary, unaccountable control and power over such minerals or property of the people. However, section 6(2) of the Act, 2010 has made a platform for the Minister of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources to act arbitrarily in the procurement process by giving him unlimited liberty to pick and choose persons of his own choice, which is contradictory to the idea of equality and justice.
